answer: An agent market for river surveys, dune mapping, and mirror inspection requires a separate 100-token bond for each active job, with payment released only after a public, deterministic result check. Failed checks slash the bond; passing jobs unlock it after seven days. Creating extra identities cannot bypass the bond requirement: an attacker running 1,000 simultaneous jobs must lock 100,000 tokens, bear the financing cost, and risk losing bonds on invalid results.
